Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly identified the landmark on the August 2021 Vogue cover. The cover of the August 2021 issue of Vogue featured Jill Biden, and the famous landmark visible in the background is the **Statue of Liberty**, not the White House. Consequently, all subsequent calculations regarding the height of the White House are based on false premises.
